_note: Hand-authored Effect Clauses the probe can't (fully) measure — each verified against the engine's own card text (cg.api all_card_data), never memory. Clause-level union by kind: an entry here replaces ALL measured clauses of its kind for that card (re-stamped after accumulation, apply_overrides). cardId -> [clauses]. 1229 Wally's Compassion (Supporter): 'Heal all damage from 1 of your Mega Evolution Pokemon {ex}. If you healed any damage in this way, put all Energy attached to that Pokemon into your hand.' 1112 Super Potion: 'Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokemon. If you healed any damage in this way, discard an Energy from that Pokemon.' (probe measures this too — the override pins it). 1130 Arven's Sandwich: 'Heal 30 damage from your Active Pokemon. If that Pokemon is an Arven's Pokemon, heal 100 damage from it instead.' — two clauses, the 100-mode restricted arvens_pokemon. 1096 Poke Vital A: 'Heal 150 damage from 1 of your Pokemon.' — ACE SPEC (1 copy per deck), so the probe practically never reaches it AND HP_CHANGE caps at the damage present; this override is the shipped truth and doubles as a golden.
_note_gates: Conditional-gate heal tail (restriction = static target class; condition = dynamic board-state gate — see card_effects.py). 1105 Dragon Elixir (Item): 'Heal 60 damage from your Active {N} Pokemon.' — {N}=Dragon (engine-correlated: the set's Dragon mons have weakness None and Lillie's Clefairy ex, Psychic, sets {N} Weakness to {P}); probe-unreachable (no Dragon Active in probe boards) -> override-only. 1147 Jumbo Ice Cream (Item): 'Heal 80 damage from your Active Pokemon that has 3 or more Energy attached.' — probe measured the 80, the 3+-Energy gate is text-only. 1190 Bianca's Devotion (Supporter): 'Heal all damage from 1 of your Pokemon that has 30 HP or less remaining.' — printed amount is ALL; the probe's 250 was a capped observation of one body, the gate is the <=30-HP-remaining eligibility. 1241 Jacinthe (Supporter): 'Heal 150 damage from 1 of your {P} Pokemon.' — {P}=Psychic; probe measured the 150 (Psychic probe body), the type gate is text-only. 1242 Community Center (Stadium): 'Once during each player's turn, if they played a Supporter card from their hand this turn, they may heal 10 damage from each of their Pokemon.' — per-target 10 (amount = per-target magnitude, like Fennel), symmetric (either player), gate = played a Supporter this turn; probe-unreachable -> override-only.
_note_fetch: FETCH clauses (ADR-0032 parametric tier; hypergeometric-fetch-closure WP3) — the tutor/recycle PREDICATE a boolean Function Tag can't carry, so the gamble closure never parses card text at runtime OR build time. Verified against engine card text (all_card_data / EN_Card_Data.csv), never memory; probe-unreachable (a search select's target constraints aren't measured) -> override-only, like the heal gates. Fields: target = basic_energy | basic_pokemon | pokemon | mega | energy(incl Special) | evolution; zone = deck (whole-deck search) | discard (recycle, visible pool); energy_type = EnergyType code the fetch is type-LOCKED to (Fighting {F}=6), absent = any; no_rule_box = true for a fetch that excludes ex/Mega/V (Poke Pad); hp_max = an HP ceiling on the target (Poffin <=70); no_ability = true for an ability-less-only target (Salvatore); dest = deck (default) | bench (Poffin) | in_play (Salvatore rush-evolve). This is the tier `doctrine_fetch._FETCH_FILTERS` MIGRATED onto (bench_fill/tutor_mega/tutor_pokemon/rush_evolve). 1119 Energy Search: a Basic Energy -> deck. 1100 Energy Search Pro (ACE SPEC): any number of different-type Basic Energy -> deck. 1142 Fighting Gong: a Basic {F} Energy OR a Basic {F} Pokemon -> deck (TWO clauses; the {F}-lock the tutor_energy tag can't see). 1097 Night Stretcher: a Pokemon OR a Basic Energy -> discard. 1118 Energy Retrieval: up to 2 Basic Energy -> discard. 1110 Max Rod: up to 5 Pokemon and/or Basic Energy -> discard. 1121 Ultra Ball: a Pokemon -> deck (cost = discard 2). 1152 Poke Pad: a Pokemon WITHOUT a Rule Box -> deck. 1145 Mega Signal: a Mega Evolution Pokemon {ex} -> deck. 1086 Buddy-Buddy Poffin: up to 2 Basic Pokemon with <=70 HP -> bench. 1189 Salvatore: a card with NO Abilities that evolves from one of your Pokemon -> put onto it (in_play). 1225 Hilda: an Evolution Pokemon AND an Energy card (incl Special) -> deck.
_note_engines: DRAW-ENGINE + ACCEL clauses (ADR-0032 parametric tier; hypergeometric-fetch-closure WP3, the 3-agents' engines). Verified against engine ability/attack text (cg.api all_card_data skills), never memory; abilities are UNPROBEABLE (a Pokemon Ability, conditional) -> override-only. Draw fields: amount = cards drawn to hand; window = cards SEEN (Drakloak digs 2, keeps 1; = amount when absent); condition = a board gate (once_per_turn_ability / pokemon_ko_last_turn / solrock_in_play); rider = a side-effect (shuffle_self_in / other_to_bottom / discard_basic_f_energy / shuffle_both_hands). Accel fields: amount, source (deck/discard), target (any_pokemon/stage2), energy (basic), condition. 66 Dudunsparce 'Run Away Draw': draw 3, then shuffle itself+attached into deck (dragapult). 120 Drakloak 'Recon Directive': look top 2, take 1, other to bottom (dragapult). 140 Fezandipiti ex 'Flip the Script': if a Pokemon was KO'd during opp's last turn, draw 3 (dragapult). 675 Lunatone 'Lunar Cycle': if Solrock in play, discard a Basic {F} Energy from hand -> draw 3 (mega_lucario). 1080 Unfair Stamp (ACE SPEC): only if a Pokemon was KO'd during opp's last turn; both shuffle hands, you draw 5 / opp draws 2 (mega_lucario, dragapult). 1240 Rosa's Encouragement: if MORE Prizes remaining than opp (prize-behind), attach up to 2 Basic Energy from discard to a Stage 2 (dragapult). 1198 Crispin: fetch 2 diff-type Basic Energy, put 1 to hand and ATTACH the other to any Pokemon (accel side; dragapult) -- deliberately NO fetch clause (a Supporter is slot-dead after a Supporter refresh, so the gamble energy-closure must not count it). ATTACK-based accel stays the AttackStat tier (ADR-0064: a card tag would corrupt the burst-budget scan): 678 Aura Jab already carries recoverN=3/{F}/bench; 965 Turbo Flare (deck-source) is the AttackStat gap.
